description: This source file contains a standalone C program that utilizes libpcap to compile and dump BPF filter expressions specific to PPP (Point-to-Point Protocol), originally adapted from fli4l 3.0. It includes main function logic for command-line argument parsing, filter compilation, and error handling.

methods.name: int main(int argc,char ** argv)
methods.description: Entry point of the program, handles argument parsing, filter compilation, and output.
